question: Select the correct spelling of the word that means 'to replace'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"supersede"** means to take the place of a person or thing previously in authority or use; to replace. (प्रतिस्थापित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The new law will supersede the old one.
 
 
 
• **"Supersede" **is the correct spelling of the word that means to replace. (प्रतिस्थापित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Smartphones have largely superseded traditional mobile phones.
